tools.name: get_hiring_runtime_gate
tools.description: Read the public Hiring intake availability gate
tools.sql: SELECT intake_status, reason_code, updated_at FROM hiring_runtime_gate WHERE id = 1 LIMIT 1

tools.name: list_my_workspaces
tools.sql: SELECT o.id AS organization_id, o.name AS organization_name, b.id AS brand_id, b.name AS brand_name, m.role FROM hiring_memberships m JOIN hiring_organizations o ON o.id=m.organization_id JOIN hiring_brands b ON b.id=m.brand_id WHERE m.user_id=:__user_id ORDER BY o.created_at DESC LIMIT 100

tools.name: create_workspace
tools.description: Create an internal organization, brand, draft requisition and owner membership
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_organizations(id,name,created_by,created_at) SELECT :organization_id,:organization_name,:__user_id,:__now WHERE length(trim(:organization_name))>0 AND length(trim(:brand_name))>0 AND length(trim(:requisition_title))>0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_brands(id,organization_id,name,created_at) SELECT :brand_id,:organization_id,:brand_name,:__now FROM hiring_organizations WHERE id=:organization_id AND created_by=:__user_id AND length(trim(:organization_name))>0 AND length(trim(:brand_name))>0 AND length(trim(:requisition_title))>0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_requisitions(id,organization_id,brand_id,title,created_at) SELECT :requisition_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:requisition_title,:__now FROM hiring_brands b JOIN hiring_organizations o ON o.id=b.organization_id WHERE b.id=:brand_id AND b.organization_id=:organization_id AND o.created_by=:__user_id AND length(trim(:organization_name))>0 AND length(trim(:brand_name))>0 AND length(trim(:requisition_title))>0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_memberships(id,organization_id,brand_id,user_id,role,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:__user_id,'owner',:__now FROM hiring_brands b JOIN hiring_organizations o ON o.id=b.organization_id WHERE b.id=:brand_id AND b.organization_id=:organization_id AND o.created_by=:__user_id AND length(trim(:organization_name))>0 AND length(trim(:brand_name))>0 AND length(trim(:requisition_title))>0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,NULL,'workspace.created',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = :organization_id AND m.brand_id = :brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id AND m.role = 'owner') AND length(trim(:organization_name))>0 AND length(trim(:brand_name))>0 AND length(trim(:requisition_title))>0

tools.name: add_workspace_member
tools.description: Owner grants a PAS user ID recruiter access to this brand
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_memberships(id,organization_id,brand_id,user_id,role,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:member_user_id,:role,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = :organization_id AND m.brand_id = :brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id AND m.role = 'owner') AND :role='recruiter' AND :member_user_id<>:__user_id AND length(trim(:member_user_id))>0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,NULL,'membership.added',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = :organization_id AND m.brand_id = :brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id AND m.role = 'owner') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships WHERE id=:operation_id)

tools.name: list_workspace_members
tools.sql: SELECT user_id, role, created_at FROM hiring_memberships WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = :organization_id AND m.brand_id = :brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id) ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 100

tools.name: list_requisitions
tools.sql: SELECT id,title,status FROM hiring_requisitions WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = :organization_id AND m.brand_id = :brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100

tools.name: create_requisition
tools.description: Create a draft requisition for internal sourcing
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_requisitions(id,organization_id,brand_id,title,created_at) SELECT :requisition_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:title,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = :organization_id AND m.brand_id = :brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id) AND length(trim(:title))>0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,NULL,'requisition.created',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = :organization_id AND m.brand_id = :brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_requisitions WHERE id=:requisition_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id)

tools.name: list_applications
tools.sql: SELECT a.id,a.stage,a.version,a.source,a.source_detail,a.basis_reference,a.contact_context,a.assignee_user_id,a.created_at,a.updated_at,c.name AS candidate_name,c.email,c.phone,c.linkedin_url,r.title AS requisition_title FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id JOIN hiring_requisitions r ON r.id=a.requisition_id WHERE a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = :organization_id AND m.brand_id = :brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id) ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC LIMIT 100

tools.name: create_linkedin_application
tools.description: Record a LinkedIn sourced candidate and application with basis, contact context, assignment and audit
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_candidates(id,organization_id,brand_id,name,email,phone,linkedin_url,created_by,created_at) SELECT :candidate_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:candidate_name,NULLIF(:email,''),NULLIF(:phone,''),:linkedin_url,:__user_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = :organization_id AND m.brand_id = :brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_requisitions WHERE id=:requisition_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AND (:linkedin_url LIKE 'https://www.linkedin.com/%' OR :linkedin_url LIKE 'https://linkedin.com/%') AND length(trim(:candidate_name))>0 AND length(trim(:basis_reference))>0 AND length(trim(:contact_context))>0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND user_id=:assignee_user_id) AND length(trim(:source_detail))>0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_applications(id,organization_id,brand_id,requisition_id,candidate_id,source,source_detail,basis_reference,contact_context,assignee_user_id,stage,version,created_by,created_at,updated_at) SELECT :application_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:requisition_id,:candidate_id,'linkedin',:source_detail,:basis_reference,:contact_context,:assignee_user_id,'submitted',1,:__user_id,:__now,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = :organization_id AND m.brand_id = :brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_requisitions WHERE id=:requisition_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AND length(trim(:source_detail))>0 AND length(trim(:basis_reference))>0 AND length(trim(:contact_context))>0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_candidates WHERE id=:candidate_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND user_id=:assignee_user_id)

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_stage_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,from_stage,to_stage,version,reason,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,NULL,'submitted',1,'LinkedIn sourced',:__user_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = :organization_id AND m.brand_id = :brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications WHERE id=:application_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id)

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'application.created',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = :organization_id AND m.brand_id = :brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id AND application_id=:application_id)

tools.name: change_application_stage
tools.description: Change application stage with optimistic version, reason, history and audit
statements: UPDATE hiring_applications SET stage=:to_stage,version=version+1,updated_at=:__now WHERE id=:application_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND version=:expected_version AND stage=:from_stage AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = :organization_id AND m.brand_id = :brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id) AND :to_stage IN ('in_review','interviewing','decision_pending','offered','hired','rejected','withdrawn') AND :to_stage<>:from_stage AND length(trim(:reason))>0 AND :from_stage IN ('submitted','in_review','interviewing','decision_pending','offered') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id)

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_stage_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,from_stage,to_stage,version,reason,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,:from_stage,:to_stage,:expected_version+1,:reason,:__user_id,:__now FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND a.version=:expected_version+1 AND a.stage=:to_stage AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = :organization_id AND m.brand_id = :brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id)

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'application.stage_changed',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = :organization_id AND m.brand_id = :brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE id=:operation_id AND application_id=:application_id)

tools.name: reassign_application
tools.description: Change an application assignee to another member of the same brand with version and append-only history
statements: UPDATE hiring_applications SET assignee_user_id=:to_user_id,version=version+1,updated_at=:__now WHERE id=:application_id AND organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND version=:expected_version AND assignee_user_id=:from_user_id AND :to_user_id<>:from_user_id AND length(trim(:reason))>0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id=:organization_id AND m.brand_id=:brand_id AND m.user_id=:__user_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id=:organization_id AND m.brand_id=:brand_id AND m.user_id=:to_user_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_assignment_events WHERE id=:operation_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE operation_id=:operation_id)

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_assignment_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,from_user_id,to_user_id,version,reason,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,:from_user_id,:to_user_id,:expected_version+1,:reason,:__user_id,:__now FROM hiring_applications a WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND a.version=:expected_version+1 AND a.assignee_user_id=:to_user_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id=:organization_id AND m.brand_id=:brand_id AND m.user_id=:__user_id)

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'application.reassigned',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_assignment_events e WHERE e.id=:operation_id AND e.application_id=:application_id AND e.organization_id=:organization_id AND e.brand_id=:brand_id AND e.actor_user_id=:__user_id)

tools.name: list_assignment_events
tools.description: List append-only assignment history for a granted application
tools.sql: SELECT from_user_id,to_user_id,version,reason,actor_user_id,created_at FROM hiring_assignment_events WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_memberships m ON m.organization_id=a.organization_id AND m.brand_id=a.brand_id AND m.user_id=:__user_id WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id) ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 100

tools.name: list_stage_events
tools.sql: SELECT from_stage,to_stage,version,reason,actor_user_id,created_at FROM hiring_stage_events WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_memberships m ON m.organization_id = a.organization_id AND m.brand_id = a.brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id WHERE a.id = :application_id AND a.organization_id = :organization_id AND a.brand_id = :brand_id) ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 100

tools.name: add_application_note
tools.description: Add a private application note and audit event
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_notes(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,body,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :note_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,:body,:__user_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_memberships m ON m.organization_id = a.organization_id AND m.brand_id = a.brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id WHERE a.id = :application_id AND a.organization_id = :organization_id AND a.brand_id = :brand_id) AND length(trim(:body))>0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'application.note_added',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_memberships m ON m.organization_id = a.organization_id AND m.brand_id = a.brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id WHERE a.id = :application_id AND a.organization_id = :organization_id AND a.brand_id = :brand_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_notes WHERE id=:note_id AND application_id=:application_id)

tools.name: list_application_notes
tools.sql: SELECT id,body,actor_user_id,created_at FROM hiring_notes WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_memberships m ON m.organization_id = a.organization_id AND m.brand_id = a.brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id WHERE a.id = :application_id AND a.organization_id = :organization_id AND a.brand_id = :brand_id) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100

tools.name: create_communication_draft
tools.description: Save an unsent email draft to the internal outbox; no send capability
statements: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_outbox(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,recipient_email,subject,body,status,actor_user_id,created_at) SELECT :draft_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,:recipient_email,:subject,:body,'draft',:__user_id,:__now FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_candidates c ON c.id=a.candidate_id WHERE a.id=:application_id AND a.organization_id=:organization_id AND a.brand_id=:brand_id AND c.email=:recipient_email AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_memberships m WHERE m.organization_id = :organization_id AND m.brand_id = :brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id) AND length(trim(:subject))>0 AND length(trim(:body))>0

INSERT OR IGNORE INTO hiring_audit_events(id,organization_id,brand_id,application_id,action,actor_user_id,operation_id,created_at) SELECT :operation_id,:organization_id,:brand_id,:application_id,'communication.draft_created',:__user_id,:operation_id,:__now WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_memberships m ON m.organization_id = a.organization_id AND m.brand_id = a.brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id WHERE a.id = :application_id AND a.organization_id = :organization_id AND a.brand_id = :brand_id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_outbox WHERE id=:draft_id AND application_id=:application_id AND status='draft')

tools.name: list_communication_drafts
tools.sql: SELECT id,recipient_email,subject,body,status,actor_user_id,created_at FROM hiring_outbox WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_memberships m ON m.organization_id = a.organization_id AND m.brand_id = a.brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id WHERE a.id = :application_id AND a.organization_id = :organization_id AND a.brand_id = :brand_id) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100

tools.name: list_application_audit
tools.sql: SELECT action,actor_user_id,created_at,operation_id FROM hiring_audit_events WHERE organization_id=:organization_id AND brand_id=:brand_id AND application_id=:application_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hiring_applications a JOIN hiring_memberships m ON m.organization_id = a.organization_id AND m.brand_id = a.brand_id AND m.user_id = :__user_id WHERE a.id = :application_id AND a.organization_id = :organization_id AND a.brand_id = :brand_id) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100
